note: All nine name variants in the input resolve to ONE legal entity: the company was incorporated 19.09.1994 as Climan Properties Private Limited (RoC Mumbai), renamed Climan Properties Limited (17.04.2000), Encon Technologies Limited (19.04.2000), Lloyds Encon Technologies (I) Limited (31.05.2011), Lloyds Steels Industries Limited (04.05.2013) and finally Lloyds Engineering Works Limited (fresh CoI 25.07.2023) - source: https://www.lloydsengg.in/about-us/history/ . 'Lloyds Steels Industries Limited' is therefore a former name of the same company, not a separate supplier. Registered office per company site: Plot No. A-5/5, MIDC Industrial Area, P.O. Murbad, Dist. Thane 421401, Maharashtra; head office A-2 Madhu Estate, Lower Parel, Mumbai - source: https://www.lloydsengg.in/contact-us/ . CIN, PAN and GSTIN could not be retrieved: zaubacorp, thecompanycheck and moneycontrol returned HTTP 403 and the search backend was unavailable, so these fields are null rather than guessed (the CIN commonly quoted for this company, L28920MH1974PLC017702, could NOT be verified and is deliberately not asserted). PAN holder type therefore also null. Role: manufacturer - own heavy-fabrication workshop at Murbad with ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and ASME U stamp, per company site (self-declared). HS 8406.81 (steam/vapour turbines) does not match the company's actual product range (pressure vessels, heat exchangers, columns, waste-heat-recovery and nuclear-plant boilers, steel-plant equipment, marine equipment, EPC) - per project rule this is not a rejection ground; the code should be corrected to the factual one (boilers/heat exchangers, e.g. 8402/8419 family) and the verdict kept as accepted_hs_corrected. No rejection: entity exists and is listed/active.
